findings.proposed_change:
Add one lemma in the first section, placed before the finite theorem:

theorem weakEquivalence_of_two_cylinder_retract {X Y : StrictOmegaCategory.{0}} (j : X ⟶ Y) (p : Y ⟶ X) (hjp : j ≫ p = 𝟙 X) (U V : G.cylinder.obj Y ⟶ Y) (hu₀ : (G.endpoint false).app Y ≫ U = 𝟙 Y) (huv : (G.endpoint true).app Y ≫ U = (G.endpoint true).app Y ≫ V) (hv₀ : (G.endpoint false).app Y ≫ V = p ≫ j) : h.streetWeakEquivalences j

Its hypotheses are `include aw kq`, with `{h}` and `G` as variables, the same as the current theorems.

Proof: move lines 223–241 of the infinite version over unchanged. They use only `hjp`, `hu₀`, `huv` and `hv₀`.

Infinite version: finish with `exact G.weakEquivalence_of_two_cylinder_retract aw kq j p hjp U V hu₀ huv hv₀`.

Finite version: finish with `exact G.weakEquivalence_of_two_cylinder_retract aw kq jb pb hjp' U V hu₀ huv hv₀`. Here `jb`, `pb` are the `inclusion.map` images and `Y.val` is the object. The hypotheses `hu₀`, `huv`, `hv₀` already have exactly this form. Both theorems then keep only their pushout-specific `hom_ext` computations for `hu₀`, `huv` and `hv₀`.
findings.benefit: Each zigzag theorem shrinks to its pushout-specific work. The Street-equivalence argument (cylinder homotopy invariance, then 2-out-of-3, then retract) lives in one place with a clear statement. Future changes to the instance setup or retract square need one edit.

findings.problem: `PushoutGluing.isPushout` (lines 461–468) and `CylinderSource.isPushout` (lines 515–531) both prove `IsPushout` from an iso `e : pushout f g ≅ Z`. Each calls `IsPushout.of_iso_pushout … e.symm`. Each then discharges the two side goals with the same pattern: `have he : pushout.inl/inr ≫ e.hom = _`, then `rw [← he, Category.assoc, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]`. That makes four copies of the same `rw` chain in this file. A fifth and sixth copy occur in TripleGlobeCylinderPushout.lean. The only real input is `inl ≫ e.hom = left` and `inr ≫ e.hom = right`. The `symm`/`hom_inv_id` bookkeeping is repeated each time.
findings.proposed_change:
State one general lemma (e.g. in a small shared file, or above `PushoutGluing`):

theorem isPushout_of_iso_hom {C} [Category C] {A B P Z : C} {f : A ⟶ B} {g : A ⟶ P} [HasPushout f g] (l : B ⟶ Z) (r : P ⟶ Z) (e : pushout f g ≅ Z) (hl : pushout.inl f g ≫ e.hom = l) (hr : pushout.inr f g ≫ e.hom = r) (hc : f ≫ l = g ≫ r) : IsPushout f g l r

Proof: `apply IsPushout.of_iso_pushout ⟨hc⟩ e.symm`. Both goals are `l ≫ e.symm.hom = pushout.inl f g`, resp. `r ≫ e.symm.hom = pushout.inr f g`. Prove each as `rw [← hl, Category.assoc, Iso.symm_hom, Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]`.

Then:
- `PushoutGluing.isPushout := isPushout_of_iso_hom d.left d.right d.iso (pushout.inl_desc _ _ _) (pushout.inr_desc _ _ _) d.condition`.
- `CylinderSource.isPushout := isPushout_of_iso_hom _ _ (modelIso hkn) (by rw [modelIso_hom]; exact piece_comparison n k false) (by rw [modelIso_hom]; exact piece_comparison n k true) (by rw [← model.map_comp, ← model.map_comp, pushout.condition])`.

The two `HasPushout` instances come from the existing `pushout` uses in this file. The same helper replaces the corresponding block in `TripleGlobeCylinderPushout.isPushout`.
findings.benefit: Each `isPushout` becomes a one-line application whose real content is the two leg identities. The `Iso.symm_hom`/`hom_inv_id` plumbing is written and checked once. A reader sees at once that the argument is "comparison iso compatible with the legs implies pushout".
